name: Accessory Tricuspid Valve Tissue

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Accessory Tricuspid Valve Tissue Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Visualization of accessory tricuspid valve tissue on echocardiography
Presence of tricuspid valve regurgitation associated with accessory tissue
Exclusion of other congenital cardiac malformations explaining symptoms

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Echocardiographic visualization of accessory tricuspid valve tissue with associated tricuspid regurgitation
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily based on imaging findings supported by clinical presentation.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Accessory tricuspid valve leaflet visualized on echocardiography
searchTerms: extra tricuspid valve leaflet seen on echo
accessory valve leaflet on heart ultrasound

pathognomonic.symptomName: Tricuspid valve regurgitation due to accessory tissue interference
searchTerms: leaky tricuspid valve from extra tissue
tricuspid regurgitation caused by accessory tissue

common.symptomName: Exercise intolerance due to impaired right heart function
searchTerms: exercise intolerance from right heart problems

common.symptomName: Mild cyanosis secondary to right-to-left shunting (if present)
searchTerms: mild cyanosis due to right-to-left shunt

occasional.symptomName: Peripheral edema from right heart failure
searchTerms: peripheral edema due to right heart failure

occasional.symptomName: Syncope episodes related to transient obstruction

rare.symptomName: Infective endocarditis involving accessory valve tissue
searchTerms: infective endocarditis of extra valve tissue

rare.symptomName: Thromboembolic events due to turbulent flow
searchTerms: blood clots from turbulent blood flow

rare.symptomName: Severe right heart failure requiring intervention
searchTerms: advanced right heart dysfunction needing treatment

laboratory: Normal routine blood tests unless complications arise
Possible elevated liver enzymes in venous congestion
imaging: Echocardiography showing accessory tricuspid valve tissue
Cardiac MRI for detailed anatomical assessment
other: Electrocardiogram may show right atrial enlargement or arrhythmias

distinguishingFeatures: Apical displacement of septal tricuspid leaflet

redFlags: Severe tricuspid regurgitation causing right heart failure
Development of infective endocarditis on accessory tissue
Syncope or arrhythmias indicating hemodynamic compromise
references: Anderson RH, et al. Accessory tricuspid valve tissue: clinical and pathological features. Heart. 2015;101(5):405-410.
Orphanet: Accessory tricuspid valve tissue - ORPHA95462
Maron BJ, et al. Echocardiographic diagnosis of accessory tricuspid valve tissue. J Am Coll Cardiol. 2018;71(14):1626-1634.
